record.official_track: AAAI Technical Track on Cognitive Modeling & Cognitive Systems
record.reason: Scope pending after full abstract and focused PDF review: AVCAffe records106 adults performing controlled collaborative tasks and uses NASA-TLX workload and SAM affect self-reports to validate task differences and benchmark audio/video classifiers. Cognitive load/fatigue is substantive, but the study is remote-work affective computing without neural/physiological recordings or clinical endpoints; whether this psychological measurement falls within requested basic biomedical scope needs adjudication.

record.title: Just Noticeable Visual Redundancy Forecasting: A Deep Multimodal-Driven Approach
record.official_track: AAAI Technical Track on Computer Vision III
record.reason: Abstract targets visual redundancy modeling for multimedia systems using saliency, depth and segmentation. Human visual perception motivates the method, but whether the study constitutes primary biological perception research requires full-text clarification. Official PDF link twice returned Internal Error; retained pending rather than excluded.

record.title: Random Walk Conformer: Learning Graph Representation from Long and Short Range
record.official_track: AAAI Technical Track on Machine Learning IV
record.reason: Scope remains ambiguous after focused PDF review. RWC has mixed biomedical/chemical/social classification, molecular solubility and physical HOMO-LUMO regression; all ablations use NCI1/ZINC and sensitivity tests use ZINC. These indicate molecular empirical emphasis, but the PCQM4Mv2 physical-chemistry arm and substantial social benchmarks make biomedical primacy unresolved. Do not exclude from generic method framing or dataset counts alone.

record.title: Networked Restless Bandits with Positive Externalities
record.official_track: AAAI Technical Track on Planning, Routing, and Scheduling
record.reason: Pending scope adjudication after PDF review: the model is explicitly grounded in chronic-disease exercise adherence with physician and peer support, and domain-motivated transition constraints. However, all evaluations use synthetic arms with randomly generated transition matrices and synthetic graphs; the measured outcomes are general policy reward/intervention benefit across budgets and topologies. Biomedical motivation is substantive, but biomedical-primary empirical qualification is unresolved; do not treat the previous exclusion as confirmed.

record.title: Identification and Estimation of the Probabilities of Potential Outcome Types Using Covariate Information in Studies with Non-compliance
record.official_track: AAAI Technical Track on Reasoning Under Uncertainty
record.reason: Pending scope adjudication: randomized-trial non-compliance and potential outcome types are framed through vaccine efficacy and clinical trials, but numerical evaluation estimates probabilities in synthetic categorical causal diagrams with fixed generic parameters. No actual trial data or explicit disease-specific simulation parameterization was established. Retain pending rather than infer inclusion or exclusion from medical motivation alone.

record.title: Probabilities of Potential Outcome Types in Experimental Studies: Identification and Estimation Based on Proxy Covariate Information
record.official_track: AAAI Technical Track on Reasoning Under Uncertainty
record.reason: Pending: complete abstract and main PDF reviewed. Vaccine/clinical-trial potential outcome types motivate the method; main-paper numerical tests use generic categorical causal-model parameters. The PDF explicitly places a case-study application in supplementary material, which was not located on the official article page or targeted search. Do not exclude before checking that application.
